map.手术预计时长（按术式统计） 使用指南: Expected Surgery Duration (by Procedure) Statistics User Guide
map.按术式录入历史时长统计均值与区间，估算本次手术预计耗时，用于排程与资源准备，纯前: Enter historical durations by procedure to get the mean and range and estimate how long the current operation will take, for scheduling and resource preparation — pure front-end statistics, for reference.
map.把同一术式的历史手术时长（分钟）粘贴进来，得到台次、均值、中位数与离散程度，用于: Paste historical durations in minutes for the same procedure to get the case count, mean, median, and spread for scheduling and turnover estimates.
map.比较均值与中位数的差异，判断是否存在少数超长手术拉高平均、影响接台安排。: Compare the mean and median to see whether a few very long operations are pulling the average up and distorting turnover planning.
map.用标准差与极差评估时长的波动范围，为手术室排程预留合理缓冲。: Use the standard deviation and range to gauge how much durations vary, reserving a sensible buffer for room scheduling.
map.：样本量 n；总和；算术均值 = 总和 ÷ n；中位数（n 为奇数取中间值，偶数: : sample size n; total; arithmetic mean = total ÷ n; median (the middle value when n is odd, the mean of the two middle values when even); minimum, maximum, and range; variance on the population definition = Σ(x − mean)² ÷ n (note it is not ÷(n−1)); standard deviation = √variance. Input accepts commas, spaces, or newlines.
map.：8 台同类手术时长 10、20、30、40、50、60、70、80 分钟：n: : eight similar operations lasting 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80 minutes: n = 8, total 360.00, mean 45.00 minutes, median 45.00 minutes, min 10, max 80, range 70.00, variance 525.00, standard deviation 22.91 minutes. The equal mean and median show a symmetric distribution, but a standard deviation of 22.91 against a mean of 45 gives a CV of about 51%, so durations vary a lot — scheduling turnover at the 45-minute mean would make about half the cases overrun, so budget with the mean plus one standard deviation or use the upper quartile.

map.排程该用均值还是中位数？: Should Scheduling Use the Mean or the Median?
map.若分布近似对称，两者接近，任选其一即可；若存在少数超长手术（右偏分布），中位数更: If the distribution is roughly symmetric the two are close and either works; with a few very long operations (a right-skewed distribution) the median is more robust. What scheduling really cares about is how long most cases take and how big the overrun risk is, so the more practical approach is to schedule by the median, buffer with the upper quartile or the mean plus 0.5–1 standard deviation, and separately identify the cause of unusually long cases (such as adhesions, complications, or surgeon experience).
map.为什么这里的方差除以 n 而不是 n−1？: Why Is the Variance Here Divided by n Rather Than n−1?
map.除以 n 得到的是总体方差，适用于「把这 8 台当作全部观察对象、只描述这组数据: Dividing by n gives the population variance, which suits "treat these 8 as all the observations and just describe their spread"; dividing by n−1 gives the sample variance used to infer the population from a sample. This tool uses the population definition, so to treat these 8 as a sample and estimate the overall variation of the procedure you must convert by n/(n−1) yourself (here 525.00 × 8/7 = 600.00, standard deviation about 24.49).
